panels.title: ⚠ THIS DASHBOARD SHOWS NO DATA (by design)

options.content:
**Every panel below is empty, and that does not mean your sandboxes are idle.**

The `pi.sandbox.*` / `pi.sandboxes.*` series these panels query are **not emitted by anything**. The names are reserved in `infra/telemetry/conventions.ts`, but no instrument records them and no metric exporter is wired. The `msb-metrics` sidecar that earlier docs described **does not exist** — the pinned `microsandbox@0.6.6` SDK exposes metrics as an on-demand pull, not an OTLP push.

**To see a VM's resource usage today:** `GET /v1/sessions/:id/metrics` — CPU, memory, disk I/O, network I/O, uptime, pulled live from the running microVM. See `docs/api-reference.md`.

**To make this dashboard work:** register a `MeterProvider` + OTLP metric exporter in `initTelemetry`, then register observable gauges that sample `SandboxProvider.metrics` per running VM (tagged `sandbox.id` + `session.id`). Steps are spelled out in `docs/observability.md` §3. The panel queries below are already the right ones — they need a producer, not a rewrite.
